report_name: Philippines Confirms Data Breaches Across 10 Government Agencies

attack_patterns.name: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests hunting for hidden or encoded PowerShell commands (`powershell.exe -w hidden -enc`), a common technique for stealthy execution and lateral movement.

attack_patterns.name: Command Obfuscation
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests hunting for encoded PowerShell commands, specifically mentioning the '-enc' flag, which is a form of command obfuscation.

attack_patterns.name: Domain Account
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests hunting for the execution of 'net user /domain', a command used for domain account discovery.

indicators.name: Hidden Encoded PowerShell Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Hidden Encoded PowerShell Execution
id: 2b1a8c9d-e3f4-4b5a-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with parameters commonly used to hide the execution window and run an encoded command payload, as suggested in a report on Philippine government breaches.
references:
  - https://bworldonline.com/technology/2026/11/10/792741/personal-data-breach-reports-filed-by-10-govt-agencies/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-11-10'
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1027.010
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' -w hidden'
      - ' -enc '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with parameters commonly used to hide the execution window and run an encoded command payload.

indicators.name: Domain Account Discovery with Net Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Domain Account Discovery with Net Command
id: f8a7b6c5-d4e3-4f2a-1b09-8c7d6e5f4a3b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'net user /domain' to enumerate domain accounts, as suggested in a report on Philippine government breaches.
references:
  - https://bworldonline.com/technology/2026/11/10/792741/personal-data-breach-reports-filed-by-10-govt-agencies/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-11-10'
tags:
  - attack.t1087.002
  - attack.discovery
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' user '
      - '/domain'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the use of 'net user /domain' to enumerate domain accounts.
